Installation complete

You will find AutoSculpt 3D in the Applications folder and in Launchpad.

To create a 3D model: File → Create a 3D model with AutoSculpt Studio…; you can also open any OBJ, STL, GLB or PLY file.

Updates are checked and installed automatically at every start (this can be changed in Tools → Preferences…). The program's language follows the Mac's and can be changed in Preferences.
